notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've just released a small update addressing a couple of issues reported by the community:

Fixed a bug where the player would stop moving after throwing a box.

Fixed a bug that prevented throwing boxes upward or downward.

Thanks for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Major Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Get ready for fresh challenges! This new update brings 20 brand-new levels and various bug fixes to make your experience smoother and more fun. Update now and take it to the next level!
